sources.claim: original HyRec includes time-dependent radiative transfer, Lyman feedback, two-photon emission/absorption/Raman scattering, and Ly-alpha diffusion
radiation field, level populations, and free electron fraction are evolved simultaneously
nonmatching subdomains can retain local states while a flux mortar acts as the coupling variable
two-photon, inverse two-photon, and Raman processes require consistent radiative transfer
resonant scattering causes frequency diffusion and recoil drift in Ly-alpha transfer
